why: reviewer (error): Hindi and English disagree on the agent of prārthayitvā: the English has the ally solicited (by the king) and then antagonised; the Hindi has the ally making a request and then being opposed. The absolutive shares its agent with the main (passive) verb virodhitam, i.e. the king: 'having solicited (it), antagonised (it)'. The Hindi must say so.
